accounting.type: mixed EEOC relief, Fairway subsidy/community programs, and government penalty; never treat as a uniform restitution total

payment_rule: outstanding is computable only if actual contractual payable balance and credited payments reliably verified. Unknown paid is NULL, not 0.
limitations: Not a comprehensive search of all court dockets or settlement administrator transaction systems
Not every consent decree proves paid/credited/distributed funds
Privacy: do not expose individual recipient names or bank details
Preserve EEOC commitments and Fairway subsidy/penalty separate
DOL agency recoveries are previously reported as recovered and not open debt
Do not compound without original loss accrual date and appropriate rate
Source pages may have future updates; snapshot date is 2026-11-20
